main_body: wooden pulpit desk with banner and side stairs
top_band: light tan cornice rim at rows 13-14 (2px) above medium brown trim at row 15
evidence: Reading a column down the main pulpit body (outside the book ornament at rows 8-12): row 12 is dark brown outline, rows 13-14 are a 2px light tan rim, row 15 is a 1px medium brown step, row 16 is an eave shadow, and rows 17-45 are the front face and base. A 2px light band at rows 13-14 is a 'rim only' cornice (matches the 'BAD rim only: top 2' guide shape), not a foreshortened top surface; even the book/pillow sits ON top of row 12 as in a pure front/side elevation.

style.evidence: While the wood and red cloth use 4-5 ramp steps and dark brown/maroon material outlines, the surfaces have large flat fills (the red banner is a solid unshaded block across rows 24-34, and the stair sides are large flat brown rectangles with only two dots) lacking the organic grain and per-tile richness of the Beodeul stall and well references.
